hebrew: תְּהֵא הַשָּׁעָה הַזּאת שְׁעַת רַחֲמִים וְעֵת רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ
translation:
May this time be an hour of mercy and a time of acceptance before You.

Translation by Gabe Seed
information: Taken from one of the lines of the Avinu Malkeinu prayer recited during the High Holiday season and on fast days.
vocalizedHe: תְּהֵא הַשָּׁעָה הֵזֹּאת שְׁעַת רַחֲמִים וְעֵת רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ
